title: ROSE scene
description: A ROSE scene file, as read by ROSE::Scene::FromJSONString. Every key the loader reaches for with .at() is required here: a missing one throws, the whole parse is abandoned, and you get an empty scene plus a "Scene string corrupt" log line.

name.description: Display name of the scene. Overwrites the auto-generated "SceneN" name.

objects.description: Every object in the scene. May be empty, but the key itself must be present.

uuid.description: A ROSE UUID: two 16-digit hex halves joined by a single separator, e.g. "a1415ebbfe6e827e-6f0aab643d65988e". The loader only checks the length, so a stray non-hex digit parses as garbage rather than an error - hence the pattern here.

vec3.description: Three numbers, x/y/z. Exactly three - the loader indexes [0..2] without a length check.

color.description: Three or four numbers, normally r/g/b/a in 0..1. With three, the alpha falls back to the behavior's default.

name.description: Looked up by ROSE::Scene::FindObjectByName. Not required to be unique; the first match wins.

uuid.description: Identity of the object, and its key in the scene's object map.

behaviors.description: Behaviors attached to this object. One entry per behavior type: the map is keyed by typeid, so a repeated typeid silently overwrites the earlier entry.

rotation.description: Euler angles in radians, applied XYZ, converted to a quaternion on load.

typeid.description: The behavior type's TypeID(). It must be registered with BehaviorFactory by the time the scene loads, or the load fails on this entry.

factoryParameters.description: Handed to the behavior's Unpack() as a ParamView. Must be an object: ParamView looks keys up by name, so an array or a null reads as empty and every parameter silently takes its default. An empty object is the correct way to say "no parameters".

params.$comment: One entry per behavior the Core module registers, mirroring that behavior's Unpack(). These are closed: an unrecognised key is almost always a typo, and ParamView answers a typo with the default rather than an error, so this is the only place it gets caught. Behaviors from a game module are not listed here and their parameters go unconstrained.

camera.title: ROSE::Camera

focalLength.description: In millimetres, against a 36x24 frame. Ignored when orthographic.

orthographicSize.description: Half-height of the orthographic view volume, in world units.

camera.$comment: Aspect ratio is deliberately absent: it belongs to the viewport and is passed to GetProjection.

drdt.description: Linear velocity, world units per second.

dTdt.description: Angular velocity: direction is the axis, magnitude the rate in rad/s.

audioSource.title: ROSE::AudioSource
audioSource.$comment: Registered by the Core module but does not override Unpack, so it reads nothing from the scene file yet.

mesh.description: Mesh id, resolved against the MeshRegistry in OnCreate rather than at parse time.

size.description: Width and height in world units. Read as a three-element vector; z is ignored.

shapeRenderable.title: ROSE::ShapeRenderable

width.description: Line width. At or below 1 the shape is drawn as lines; above, it is expanded to a triangle ribbon.

shapeRenderable.$comment: The point list is not readable from JSON yet - a shape is driven from code.

geometryRenderable.title: ROSE::GeometryRenderable

texture.description: Setting this also marks the renderable textured.

geometryRenderable.$comment: Vertices, indices and topology are public members filled from code, not from the scene file.

position.description: Top-left corner in window pixels; z is ignored.

size.description: Width and height in window pixels; z is ignored.
